title: LearnHub problem details (RFC 7807)
description: Body of every HTTP error produced by the gateway and by services. Served as application/problem+json.

type.description: URI reference identifying the problem type; 'about:blank' when no more specific type exists.

title.description: Short, human-readable summary; stable per status.

status.description: HTTP status code. Services may add further 4xx/5xx values in later specs; the gateway produces these.

detail.description: Explanation specific to this occurrence. Must not expose internals or secrets.

instance.description: Request path that produced the error.

correlationId.description: Same value as the X-Correlation-Id response header.

examples.title: Too Many Requests
examples.detail: Rate limit exceeded for this client address.
